shots.name: Establishing
shots.note: Range built to plate scale. Aircraft held to roughly a tenth of frame width — the altitude is the point, not the plane.

lines.s: Snow to the horizon. Nothing down there moves.
A military transport crosses the range, small against the peaks.

narr.s: There are places on this earth no road was ever meant to reach. So men fly over them.
I have the same dream. It always starts a long way up, where there is nothing underneath.

shots.name: The Transport
shots.note: Camera rigged to the port side and drifting forward along the fuselage. Ridge line streams behind to carry the speed.

lines.s: Four engines. Ice on the leading edge.
Whatever it is carrying, it is carrying a long way from anyone.

narr.s: And they carry things across that should have been left where they were found.
I have never been on that plane. I know exactly what it sounds like.

shots.name: The Cage
shots.note: Reynolds wipes frame right at the halfway mark and clears the cage. Creature stays in shadow until the eyes carry the cut.

lines.s: A steel cage fills the hold, chained down to the deck.
COLONEL REYNOLDS watches it. He does not blink.
Something inside breathes. Slow. Far too large.
Its eyes open. They burn red.

narr.s: This one had been asleep a long time. Long enough that somebody thought a cage would hold it.
There is a cage in the hold, and men standing round it who think a cage is enough.

shots.name: It Wakes
shots.note: Roar takes a 3-degree lens punch and a low-frequency shake. Chain links are simulated and scatter live on the deck.

lines.s: The creature rises to its full height.
It roars — the sound goes straight through the airframe.
The chains pull taut.
They snap. Links ring off the deck.

narr.s: It did not care for the chains. It cared even less for the men who fitted them.
It always wakes up. It always looks straight at me.

shots.name: Breach
shots.note: Cabin roll is carried by camera tilt and by loose objects sliding to the low side — no set gimbal needed at this stage.

lines.s: It takes the bars in its jaws and tears the cage open.
Open fire!
Muzzle flash fills the hold. The rounds do nothing.
The deck tilts. Men go down and slide.

narr.s: You may as well shoot at weather.
I want to tell them not to bother.

shots.name: Fire In The Hold
shots.note: Hull opens on the port side — daylight and snow stream in against the fire. Fog tints toward ember as the hold fills.

lines.s: A fuel line goes. Fire floods the port side.
The hull opens. Sky, and then snow, screaming in.
The creature stands in the fire. It is not burning.

narr.s: Fire took the hold. Nothing in the fire was burning.
Then the fire. It walks through the fire and nothing happens to it.

shots.name: Impact
shots.move: Locked wide, crane up on smoke
shots.note: Camera is planted on the ridge opposite and left there. Fireball, shockwave, debris and the snow blast are all one event at frame 1140.

lines.s: The transport comes down trailing flame.
It hits the ridge.
The mountain takes the sound.
Smoke stands up off the snow and does not stop.

narr.s: Then the mountain came up to meet them, and the mountain kept the sound.
And then the mountain. And then I am awake.

shots.name: Waking
shots.note: Hard cut out of the fireball into black. She comes up on the first frame — the crash was hers. Only the window carries her, so the room stays a silhouette.

lines.s: ZARA (20s) comes up out of the dark, gasping.
The crash was a dream. It does not feel like one.
She sits in the window light, shaking.
She waits for her hands to stop. They do not.

narr.s: Two thousand miles away, a woman wakes out of a fire she has never been anywhere near.
Every night. Then my own ceiling, and my own hands, and neither of them are steady.

shots.name: The Cigarette
shots.note: Lighter flare is the only warm source in the room and it is on her hands, not her face. Two takes of the shake — the flame should not find the tip first time.

lines.s: She finds the pack by feel.
The lighter takes three tries.
Smoke. Her hands settle. Her eyes do not.

narr.s: She has learned what to do with her hands when they shake.
Three tries with a lighter. That is my whole morning.

shots.name: The Scars
shots.note: The reveal of the scene. Top light and steam, no face. Prosthetic scars run old and layered — she has been surviving since she was a child, and the make-up has to date them.

lines.s: Water. Steam takes the room.
She stands under it and does not move.
The camera finds her back.
Scars. Old ones, over older ones. A childhood of them.

narr.s: And she has learned to keep her back to the mirror. Everything that happened to her is written on it.
I do not look at my back any more. I already know what it says.

shots.name: The Cave
shots.note: Flashback grade: one lantern, one shaft, everything else black. YOUNG ZARA is eleven. The chasm is in frame from the first second so the audience is ahead of them.

lines.s: A cave the size of a church. Dust in a shaft of light.
YOUNG ZARA (11) follows her FATHER along the ledge.
They are hunting something. The lantern swings.
Below them, the floor simply ends.

narr.s: It starts in a cave. A lantern, a ledge, and a father who took his daughter hunting.
I was eleven. He took me hunting because I asked him to.

shots.name: The Rope
shots.move: Low across the chasm, whip down
shots.note: His slip is a real drop onto a decelerator. She hits the lip hard — pad the ledge. Rope is dressed to a stone anchor and takes the load on camera.

lines.s: The rock goes out from under him.
He drops. She is already on the floor, reaching.
Her hand closes on his. It holds.
The rope to the stone pulls taut and stays.

narr.s: The rock gave. She caught him. For a moment she was strong enough.
The rock went. And I had him. I had him.

shots.name: He Lets Go
shots.move: Tight on the hands, tilt into the dark
shots.note: The whole film is in this shot. Play the rope parting in the cutaway, then hold the two hands. He decides. Camera goes with him and finds nothing.

lines.s: The rope begins to part. One strand. Then three.
He looks up at her. He has already done the arithmetic.
Let go, Zara.
She does not. So he does.
He falls into the dark and the dark takes him.

narr.s: The rope began to count itself out.
For eleven seconds I was strong enough.

shots.name: Jax Calls
shots.note: Cut back on the buzz. Screen light is the only movement in frame — it strobes the ceiling while she stands in the bathroom door and does nothing.

lines.s: A phone buzzes itself around the table.
The screen reads JAX.
She stands in the doorway and lets it ring.
It stops. The room goes dark again.

narr.s: She has not answered a telephone in a year.
That is why I do not pick up the phone.

shots.name: Balcony
shots.note: Pull the city up behind her as we leave. She is in a towel, in the cold, on purpose. End of scene — hold the wide two beats longer than feels comfortable.

lines.s: A towel. The cold does not seem to reach her.
She smokes and watches the city do nothing.
Whatever is coming, it has already started.
The ember is the brightest thing for a mile.

narr.s: But the dead keep their appointments. And hers was already on its way.
I have never once said no to Jax. Not really.

shots.name: Jax Arrives
shots.note: He lets himself in. Play it like a man who has done this a hundred times and still knocks.

lines.s: JAX comes in without waiting to be asked.
You are going to want to sit down.

shots.name: The Job
shots.note: The key exists only as a photograph in this scene. Keep the real one out of frame until Tokyo.

lines.s: An antique key. A Collector has it.
He puts a photograph on the table.
It opens a castle. Reynolds wants it.
So we take it first.

shots.name: The Bunker
shots.note: Reynolds is down an eye since the crash. Five operators, one empty chair. The castle sits over the table in light.

lines.s: Underground. COLONEL REYNOLDS, one eye now.
Five elite soldiers. A castle turning in the light.
We found it. And something is living in it.
They need the key to go in the front door.

shots.name: Captain Rex
shots.move: Behind him, tilt to the mask
shots.note: From the back only. The mask goes on last and the eye lights come up red — the same red as the thing in the hold.

lines.s: Sir, we need a better plan.
Reynolds smiles. There is a sixth soldier.
CAPTAIN REX, seen from behind, arming up.
The mask locks. The eyes come up red.

shots.name: One Last Dance
shots.note: She says no. The no is about her father and Jax knows it. Then she nods, and the film starts.

lines.s: One last dance, Z.
No.
She is not thinking about the money. She is thinking about a rope.
She nods.

shots.name: Tokyo
shots.note: Establisher. Everything from here to the rollover happens in one city and one grade: wet street, hard neon.

lines.s: Tokyo. Ten million people and none of them looking.

narr.s: Tokyo. Where everything is for sale.
Tokyo. Nobody here looks up.

shots.name: The Deal
shots.note: The pass happens on the move and off-centre. Crowd carries the frame, not the actors.

lines.s: A market. Steam, lanterns, three hundred people.
They find the COLLECTOR between two stalls.
Money goes one way. The KEY goes the other.

narr.s: Including a key nobody has turned in a thousand years.
A key, for money. It should have taken four minutes.

shots.name: Rex At The Stall
shots.note: Rex asks once. The Collector does not need to be asked twice — he points.

lines.s: CAPTAIN REX steps into the lanterns.
The Collector points. He does not even hesitate.

narr.s: The hunter was one stall behind them.
It took two. Then he found us.

shots.name: Market Chase
shots.note: Camera runs ahead of them and lets the soldiers close from the back of frame. Stalls go over.

lines.s: They run. The crowd is a wall and then a river.
Rex sends his men through it after them.

shots.name: Onto The Highway
shots.note: Wheels first. The elevated road is the set — nothing above it but sodium light.

lines.s: The car comes onto the elevated road doing a hundred.

shots.name: Fire From The SUV
shots.note: Rex leans out of the military SUV and puts rounds through the back glass. Squibs on the pillar, glass on the rig.

lines.s: A military SUV comes up on their shoulder.
Rex leans out and fires.
The back window goes.

shots.name: Jax Shoots Back
shots.move: Reverse, out of the back window
shots.note: Two hits, two spins. Keep the wrecks alive behind them — they are the ones that end the sequence.

lines.s: Jax finds the guns under the seat.
He fires back through the empty window.
Two SUVs let go and start to spin.

shots.name: Rollover
shots.note: Rex is half out of his door reaching for the key when the spinning wrecks arrive. Everything goes over at once.

lines.s: Rex climbs out to jump for the key.
The spinning wrecks arrive first.
Impact. The car goes over and keeps going.
Chaos, and then nothing moving.

narr.s: And it ends the way these things always end.
I remember the road. Then the roof. Then the road again.

shots.name: Out Of The Wreck
shots.note: She comes round first. Door goes with a boot, twice.

lines.s: Zara comes round upside down in the smoke.
She wakes Jax. The door goes on the second kick.
They crawl out onto the road.

shots.name: The Fist
shots.note: The arm hangs out of the crushed window with the key in it. Then the eyes come on and the hand does not move.

lines.s: Rex is pinned in his own SUV. His arm hangs out.
The KEY is in his fist.
Jax pulls. The eyes come on red.
The hand does not open.

narr.s: He would not open his fist.
The key was in his fist. He would not let go.

shots.name: The Cut
shots.note: One swing with a torn panel. We stay on her face for it, not on the arm.

lines.s: Soldiers are getting up around them.
Zara picks up a piece of the car.
One swing.

narr.s: So she took the fist.
So I stopped asking.

shots.name: Into The Night
shots.note: Jax carries the hand until he has the key out of it. Rex screams behind them and does not stop.

lines.s: Jax takes the key out of the hand and drops it.
Behind them Rex is screaming. They keep walking.

narr.s: Nothing is ever taken from a man like that. Only borrowed.
I would do it again.

shots.name: Safehouse
shots.note: First still air since Tokyo. She tapes herself up, he cleans somebody else’s blood off the key.

lines.s: A safehouse. One lamp. Two people breathing again.
What is so special about this key?
It is from the golden era of the Wajiro Kingdom.

shots.name: The Golden Era
shots.move: Crane up over the training ground
shots.note: The only warm, wide, beautiful frame in the film. Hundreds training. Gold everywhere, and it means something.

lines.s: Long ago. A kingdom the colour of a coin.
Hundreds of warriors and samurai, training.
They were strong. But the power was in the blades.

narr.s: Wajiro. A thousand years of gold.
A kingdom the colour of a coin.

shots.name: It Is A Map
shots.move: Macro on the key, then her eyes
shots.note: The writing is on the shaft of the key and it is a map. Her line at the end is flat, not fierce — that is scarier.

lines.s: She turns the key to the light. Writing, tiny.
It is a map. I can read this.
Rex frightened me, Z.
I took his hand. If he comes back I will finish him.

shots.name: The Metal Hand
shots.note: Sound sells it. Every finger is a separate servo and none of them are quiet.

lines.s: A cold room. A new hand, and it is not a hand.
The fingers close one at a time.

narr.s: They built the hunter a new hand.
I did not know they were building him a new one.

shots.name: The Slap
shots.note: Reynolds is shouting at a machine and has not noticed.

lines.s: Three billion dollars. And a girl beat you.
He slaps him.

shots.name: My Prey
shots.note: No wind-up. The hand is just suddenly at his throat and the Colonel’s feet are off the floor.

lines.s: The red comes up brighter.
The metal hand takes Reynolds by the throat.
Soldiers follow orders. Hunters follow blood.
She is my prey now.

shots.name: The Forest
shots.note: Montage starts here. Three locations, no dialogue, keep the cuts hard.

lines.s: Days of walking. The forest does not thin out.

narr.s: After that there were no more roads.
Nine days of walking.

shots.name: The Fall
shots.note: They climb, the ledge lets go, and they drop out of frame. Whole shot is the ground failing.

lines.s: A rock face, and wind that will not let them speak.
The ground opens under them.
They fall.

narr.s: Only forest, and rock, and a ledge that let go.
Then the ground stopped being ground.

shots.name: The River
shots.note: Cold, fast and black. They go under, and we go to black with them.

lines.s: They land in a river nobody has ever seen.
It takes them like they weigh nothing.
Everything goes black.

narr.s: And a river under the world that had never carried anyone.
And the water took us somewhere nobody has ever been.

shots.name: The Grey Shore
shots.note: They wake in silt, covered in it. Whatever is in the air here, it is not good air.

lines.s: A grey shore under the world. They are still alive.
The smell arrives before anything else does.

narr.s: It put them down on a grey shore.
We woke up grey.

shots.name: The Battlefield
shots.note: An army died here and nobody buried it. Rusted blades standing where they fell. Rats own the place now.

lines.s: An army lies where it fell. Nobody came back for it.
Bones, horses, rusted swords standing in the dirt.
Rats, in numbers.

narr.s: An army died here. Nobody ever came to collect it.
Men died here in their thousands and nobody ever came back for them.

shots.name: The Castle
shots.note: The reveal of the film. Black stone and gold, and they are two dots at the bottom of frame.

lines.s: They push through the dead trees.
THE CASTLE OF WAJIRO. Black stone. Gold.
They stand very small in front of the gates.

narr.s: This is what the army died in front of.
And then we saw what they had died in front of.

shots.name: No Keyhole
shots.note: Wolves and flying snakes in the carving. Both of them are promises.

lines.s: Wolves. Flying snakes. A symbol in the middle.
There is no keyhole, Z.

shots.name: Life Current
shots.move: Close on hands and the symbol
shots.note: Water does nothing. The word is Yorukami-Chi and it does not mean water.

lines.s: Jax wets his finger and draws. Nothing.
Yorukami-Chi. Life current.
It means blood.
She takes his hand and opens it.

shots.name: The Doors Open
shots.note: The symbol takes the blood and lights. Everything after this is inside.

lines.s: She paints the symbol in his blood.
It glows. The ground moves.
The gates open.
We are in.

narr.s: The castle asked for blood. They paid it.
It wanted blood. Of course it wanted blood.

shots.name: The Sleeper
shots.note: Read it as a statue for three full seconds. Dust on it, dust everywhere, nothing moving.

lines.s: A hall of pillars. A stone table in the middle.
Something enormous is asleep on it, under the dust.
It looks carved.

narr.s: Something had been left inside to keep the place.
There was something asleep in the first hall. We walked straight past it.

shots.name: It Smells Blood
shots.note: Dust comes off it in a sheet as it breathes in. The yellow eye opens last.

lines.s: Somewhere in the castle, an open cut.
Dust slides off a shoulder the size of a car.
The eye opens. Yellow.
It stands, and it goes looking.

narr.s: A thousand years asleep. It woke for one open cut.
My hand was still open. I think that is what woke it.

shots.name: The Giants
shots.note: Twenty-foot samurai, lacquer still good. Obsidian eyes: as the torch moves the reflection tracks them, and nobody says anything about it.

lines.s: The quiet in here has weight. It presses on the ears.
Giant samurai line the hall. Lacquer, not stone.
Their eyes are polished black. They follow the light.

narr.s: The hall remembers everyone who walks it.
The quiet in there had a weight to it.

shots.name: The Moving Gold
shots.move: Hold on the rafters after they exit
shots.note: They leave frame and the camera stays two seconds too long. A gold beam in the roof turns out to have scales.

lines.s: They go deeper. The camera stays.
High in the rafters, a gold beam moves.
A python the width of a man tastes the air where Jax stood.

narr.s: And not everything in that roof is gold.
And I swear the statues watched us go.

shots.name: Her Own Blood
shots.move: Close, her hand on the wall
shots.note: She asks, he cannot, and she does not argue — she opens her own hand instead. That is the whole relationship in four seconds.

lines.s: I need blood again.
Z, I can’t. Not again.
She cuts her own palm instead and wets the stone.
The letters take the blood and glow.

shots.name: The Shadow
shots.note: The shadow is the wolf and we never see the wolf. It takes the light out for half a second.

lines.s: The secret chamber. Secured by Rymon.
A dead warrior. I don’t care about ghosts.
Something enormous crosses behind them and takes the light.

shots.name: The Bandage
shots.note: She nearly kisses him. He sees her open palm instead and ties it up. Then they split up, which is the mistake.

lines.s: She pulls him close. The fear turns into something else.
He looks at her mouth. Then at her bleeding hand.
He bandages it instead.
You go that side. Be careful.

narr.s: There was a moment. They let it pass.
I nearly kissed him. He bandaged my hand.

shots.name: The Blue Bottle
shots.note: Only cold light in the castle. Whatever is in the bottle is the reason the corridor is this narrow.

lines.s: A corridor of rotted scrolls, barely wide enough.
A small altar. A bottle. Something blue, and it is lit from inside.

narr.s: Then they split up. That was the mistake.
Then we split up. I have to live with that.

shots.name: The Iron Door
shots.note: Jax alone at the end of a bridge with a door built for something bigger than him.

lines.s: Jax walks a bridge with nothing under it.
A door of iron and spikes. He pushes. It does not care.

shots.name: Two Red Eyes
shots.slug: INT. BEYOND THE IRON DOOR — CONTINUOUS
shots.move: On the floor with them, dust
shots.note: Door goes, they go over, and the room starts knocking. Two red eyes at the far end, and they are not the wolf’s yellow.

lines.s: On three. The door gives and takes them with it.
Dust. Then the floor starts to knock. Thump. Thump.
Two red eyes open in the dark at the far end.

narr.s: The door came down. Something at the far end of the dark stood up.
Whatever came through that door was not the wolf.

shots.name: Run
shots.note: The beast is faster than they are and the shot should say so. Claws take the stone up behind them.

lines.s: The roar arrives before the animal does.
RUN!
It is faster than them. It was always going to be.

shots.name: The Jump
shots.note: He clears it. She goes second with the thing’s breath on her.

lines.s: The floor ahead is gone. Jax jumps.
ZARA — JUMP!
She jumps.

shots.name: The Collapse
shots.move: With her as the floor goes
shots.note: She lands it. The landing is what kills it. The wolf howls from above and does not follow.

lines.s: She lands. The stone cracks under her.
JAX!
The floor goes and she goes with it.

shots.name: The Ritual Circle
shots.move: Up from the floor, then hold on her
shots.note: Gold, a rotting king, an eight-foot suit of armour with a spear. She has landed in the middle of a circle of skulls and broken one. End of the reel on her face doing nothing at all.

lines.s: She hits stone. Gold everywhere. A king rotting in a frame.
An eight-foot armour stands in the corner holding a spear.
She is lying in a circle of skulls. One of them broke under her.
Black blood comes out of it and moves on its own.
Jax is shouting her name. She cannot hear him any more.

narr.s: She came down in a circle of skulls, and broke one.
The floor took me. I came down in a circle of skulls and broke one open.

shots.name: No Answer
shots.slug: INT. CASTLE PASSAGE — THE BROKEN FLOOR
shots.note: The wolf loses interest and goes. That is worse — it leaves him alone with a hole and no answer.

lines.s: The dust is still turning in the air.
The wolf snarls once and goes back into the dark.
ZARA!
His own voice comes back to him. Nothing else does.

shots.name: Breaking Through
shots.note: No thinking. He goes through the planks with a shoulder and takes the grate with a boot.

lines.s: He finds a stair. It is blocked. He does not slow down.
The wood goes. Then the grate.

shots.name: The Descent
shots.note: He is running blind down a stair he cannot see the bottom of, shouting the whole way.

lines.s: ZARA! I’M COMING!
He takes the door off its lock and keeps going down.

shots.name: The Blood Rises
shots.move: Close on the pool, tilt up
shots.note: The black blood does not dry and it does not run downhill. It goes up.

lines.s: Zara has not moved. Neither has the silence.
The black blood is bubbling.
It leaves the floor and climbs.

narr.s: The blood in that room does not dry, and it does not run downhill.
I could not move. I could hear it climbing the walls.

shots.name: The Gate
shots.note: Cut against the chamber. His hands are opening up on the stone and he is not stopping.

lines.s: A gate. He picks up a rock and starts on the lock.
Sparks. His hands are bleeding. He does not notice.

shots.name: The Formation
shots.note: Smoke hardens into eight feet of obsidian. The katana arrives out of the fog, then the rest of the arsenal. The eye slits light purple, not red — this is not Rex.

lines.s: The smoke thickens in the middle of the circle.
Legs. A torso. A helmet.
A katana forms in its hand out of nothing.
Daggers and shuriken hang around it like a halo.
Two purple flames open in the eye slits.

narr.s: It was building something. It had built it before.
It made itself a body out of the dark. Then it made a sword.

shots.name: The Royal Doors
shots.move: In with him through the doors
shots.note: He arrives and the room is empty. The crash is what breaks her trance.

lines.s: The main chamber…
He puts a shoulder through the doors.
The armour is not there. The room is empty.
Jax…

shots.name: The Strike
shots.note: Rig for a lift and a stab with nothing on either end. Eight feet off the floor, legs still going.

lines.s: I’ve got you, Z!
Mid-run, something takes him off the floor.
A blade goes through him and there is no blade.
He coughs. His legs are still running.

shots.name: The Execution
shots.note: One cut. The body goes down and the head does not.

lines.s: An invisible hand closes on his throat.
A slash. The body drops.
The head stays in the air.

shots.name: The Blood Reveal
shots.move: Slow push as the shape fills in
shots.note: The film pays off here: the blood finds the surfaces and paints a king who was standing there the whole time.

lines.s: Blood comes out of him and never reaches the floor.
It sticks to something. Shoulders. A chest plate.
A helmet.
THE WAJIRO KING, painted in Jax, holding his head.

narr.s: And the blood showed them what had been standing there the whole time.
All of him went to painting something that was already there.

shots.name: Frozen
shots.note: No scream. She has no air. Hold two beats past comfortable and cut on the thunder.

lines.s: Her mouth opens.
Nothing comes out of it.

narr.s: I had no air. I could not scream.

shots.name: The Great War
shots.move: Push through the rain to the hill
shots.note: Cut on thunder and war horns. Mud, rain, smoke, fire. The same pose as the chamber, a thousand years earlier.

lines.s: Thunder. Horns.
A field of mud and bodies under a burning sky.
The KING stands on a hill of the dead in the same pose.
In his hand, another king’s head.

narr.s: He had done this before. A thousand years before.
I know what he is now.

shots.name: The Surrender
shots.move: Wide, the whole field goes down
shots.note: Half the army runs. The other half goes to its knees in one move. Whatever it costs, it is the shot.

lines.s: He roars, and the war stops.
Half of them throw down their swords and run.
The other half kneel where they stand.

narr.s: Half an army ran. The other half knelt in the mud.
A whole army knelt to him once.

shots.name: Even The Beast
shots.move: Low, the wolf lowers its head
shots.note: The animal from the castle, alive and well, and it kneels too. That is the reveal of the sequence.

lines.s: The GIANT WOLF stands at his right hand. Alive.
Even it lowers its head.

narr.s: Even the animal put its head down.
Even the animal.

shots.name: Part II: The Demon
shots.note: Freeze on the silhouette against the burning sky and put the card up.

lines.s: A god of war alone in a field of bowed heads.
The frame stops moving.
PART II — THE DEMON

narr.s: This was never a story about a key.
I did not kneel.

shots.name: The Hunter Returns
shots.move: Low on the water, ship into frame
shots.note: Fog on the water and one hull cutting it. The castle is a silhouette ahead of them the whole shot.

lines.s: Black water. Fog that does not move.
An assault ship comes through it.
Ahead: the castle.

narr.s: And the hunter is still coming.

shots.name: Run, Little Rabbit
shots.move: Slow push onto Rex at the bow
shots.note: The arm is finished now — blue in the joints, and it sounds expensive. Five operators behind him. Last line, then black.

lines.s: CAPTAIN REX at the bow. He does not blink.
The new hand closes. Clank. Blue light in the knuckles.
Five of them behind him, kitted for a war.
Run, little rabbit. The wolf is coming.
